verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is API-first, with a RESTful JSON API, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and many SDKs covering a wide range of banking operations: Pix, boletos, transfers, card acquiring, corporate cards, splits, bill and tax payments, and webhooks. However, there is no explicit UI-parity claim. Approvals are routed to the Web Banking UI, and website features such as CDI yield, digital-asset trading and card-machine receivables have no evidenced API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API-side payment approval, evidenced API coverage of investments, digital-asset trading and card-machine receivables, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
